description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Vermont Statutes Annotated — Vermont state law — by citation. "13 V.S.A. 2301" is murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does 13 VSA 2301 say" or to check a Vermont statute a case relies on.

title.description: Vermont title number, e.g. "13" (crimes), "23" (motor vehicles), "15" (domestic relations).

title: Vt Statute
